name: commons-pre-balloons-v1
description: ⭐ CONTROL: THE COMMONS AS IT SHIPPED FROM 09/09/2026 UNTIL 12/09/2026, before Dean ruled in the plain-action balloons and the Village Store. It reproduces that game EXACTLY and pins every one of the sixteen leaves the flip moved at its pre-flip value, plus the commons leaves themselves: balloons pay their four bespoke rewards (Draw 4, Build at a discount of 4, Sow 4 from hand, Harvest any building even if not full), a flight costs two barn cards of differing crops, the Aerodrome exists only when Vegetable is among the decks, and there are no coins. ⭐ WHY IT EXISTS: packages/sim/fixtures/{2,3,4}p-commons-pre-balloons-opening.json were recorded against that game and replay against this file, following the fixtures convention that a fixture belongs to the game of the day it was captured and gains a marker only when that game becomes an arm. It is also the paired control any balloon-or-Store delta should be read against. ⛔ NO LEVEL FROM IT IS COMPARABLE WITH reference-v16, which is cut on the new shipped rules.
